The Participle Clause: Present and Past Participle
You can use participle clauses after a noun in the same way as relative clauses. This gives more information about the noun.
You can use being + past participle in the same way as a continuous passive relative clause:

The poem being read by the actor was written by my wife.
(= The poem that is being read by the actor was written by my wife).

The cake being eaten at the wedding was made in Italy.
(= The cake that is being eaten at the wedding).

images.text: One of the art forms that has held special importance over the centuries in Indian culture has been dance. Styles of dance being performed now are centuries old. Originally, dancers had performed in temples as a form of worship. Musicians and dancers had been considered servants of god and were respected and encouraged in their art.

One of the most famous classical temple dances is called Odissi, which originated in eastern India. Sculptures being found in the temples of Orissa prove that the Odissi dance is hundreds of years old. These sculptures show just how significant Odissi had been at that time.
At first, only the Maharis, or temple dancers had trained to dance the Odissi.  The Maharis had chosen to dedicate their lives to the temple so they devoted themselves to perfecting their dance. They did not marry because it was thought that they were married to the god of the temple.

They would perform the dance inside the temple for the god without being watched by anyone else. In fact, all classical temple dance was created as a form of meditation, worship, and devotion rather than as a performing art.
After the Mahari tradition had eventually faded, a new group of dancers took over the Odissi tradition. The dancers being chosen were young boys called Gotipuas. The Gotipuas were the first to bring Odissi outside of the temple. Before the Gotipuas started dancing the Orissa, it had never been seen by other people. The exquisite ancient dance being enjoyed today is just one of the examples of the rich beauty of ancient Indian culture.
